Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Positional Cue
Description: Displays upcoming rear/flank attacks from Wrath Combo through IPC, with an action icon, approximate GCD countdown, sector indicator and optional sound cue. Requires Wrath Combo. Settings: /pcue.
Punchline: Upcoming positional attacks with visual and sound cues.
Changelog: Added plugin icon, shared CheesyChiz catalog, /positionalcue alias and on/off/sound/help commands. In-game validation pending.
